final_answer: Endicott Mansion is a directional path-tracing puzzle on a 3x3 grid of rooms. The wall arrows define a continuous serpentine route: Top row left-to-right (1,1→1,2→1,3), middle row right-to-left (2,3→2,2→2,1), bottom row left-to-right (3,1→3,2→3,3), then to the EXIT. Quincy (plain/normal view) and The Ghost (inverted view) traverse mirrored paths, picking one framed icon per room (a 'common' icon when both agree, differing when views differ). Tracing this snake path collects the tea cups (the white circles / the tea-cup counter at the top) and yields the answer via the chosen icons.
